info.name: OrderFlow REST — local smoke flow
info.description: Sequential synthetic-data checks for the shared Express/NestJS REST contract. Set baseUrl to expressBaseUrl or nestBaseUrl, then run the collection in order. Run it once per implementation. Concurrency is covered separately by the integration suites.

exec: pm.test('healthy API and database', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('ok'); });

pm.test('product created with five units', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p.stockAvailable).to.eql(5); pm.expect(p.unitPriceMinor).to.eql(1250); pm.collectionVariables.set('productId', p.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('orderKey', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}')); });

pm.test('order reserved at captured price', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('reserved'); pm.expect(o.totalMinor).to.eql(2500); pm.expect(o.items[0].unitPriceMinor).to.eql(1250); pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId', o.id); });
pm.test('replay returns same order', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')); });

item.name: 05 Reject changed request under same key

exec: pm.test('key conflict is explicit', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'); });

pm.test('stock deducted only once', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const p = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId')); pm.expect(p.stockAvailable).to.eql(3); });

pm.test('stock restored exactly once', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const p = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId')); pm.expect(p.stockAvailable).to.eql(5); });
